Here’s a tight action plan based on the patterns you shared.

Staffing and scheduling
- Fri–Sun dinner (18:00 peak; also 17:00–19:30 window): add 1 line cook, 1 expo/packer, and 1 runner/handoff focused on delivery. Manager on the floor 17:00–20:00. No breaks 17:00–19:00; shift them earlier.
- Lunch (11:00): have the line live by 10:30. Add 1 cashier/host 10:45–12:30 Fri–Sun. Pre-fire staples at 10:15.
- Late window (21:00): keep a lean, cross-trained crew (1 cook + 1 expo/packer + 1 FOH) to handle a smaller but steady bump.
- Slow windows (8:00 and 14:00): run a skeleton crew (1 cook + 1 FOH). Use this time for prep, with one on-call swing who can arrive within 30 minutes if orders spike.
- Delivery is your top channel: assign a dedicated delivery packer/handoff during 11:00–12:30 and 17:00–20:00, especially Fri–Sun.
- Plan by season: staff/inventory up for March’s spike; scale hours and push promos in April’s lull.

Flow and prep
- Pre-batch before rush: portion proteins, par-cook items, and set sides/sauces by 10:30 and 16:30. Label and time-stamp.
- Dedicated packing station: hot hold, labels with customer name/app, sealed bags, and clear QC checks. Staging shelves by app (DoorDash/UberEats/etc.).
- Separate pickup path: a clearly marked shelf/spot near the entrance so takeout/delivery doesn’t block dine-in.
- Order pacing: route dine-in vs. off-premise on your KDS. If quoted times exceed targets (e.g., 10 min lunch, 14 min dinner), throttle delivery menus or pause low-margin items until the board clears.
- Expo controls the pass: calls ticket times, releases orders in batches, and coordinates with the delivery handoff so drivers wait under 3 minutes.

Revenue ideas for high-volume, low-revenue windows (mismatch at 8:00, 14:00, 18:00)
- 8:00
  - Shift from single low-price items to bundles (e.g., breakfast main + side + coffee at a set price).
  - Add paid premium add-ons (bacon/avocado/extra egg). Set a delivery minimum (e.g., $15).
  - Replace blanket discounts with “spend-and-save” thresholds (free coffee over $12).
- 14:00
  - Late-lunch/snack combos (half-sandwich + soup + drink) and shareable sides add-ons.
  - Double loyalty points Mon–Wed at 14:00. Promote fast pickup/curbside to capture quick breaks.
  - Office/catering minis (tray of 6–8 portions) with a per-person price.
- 18:00
  - Tighten discounts 17:30–19:00 and raise free-delivery thresholds. Highlight family bundles (feeds 3–4) to lift ticket size.
  - Add high-margin upsells in-app and table-side (extra side, dessert, premium toppings).
  - If delivery is strong, price the delivery menu 8–12% above dine-in to cover fees and lift AOV.

Top 3 priorities
1) Lock the Fri–Sun dinner rush plan: add a dedicated delivery packer + expo, separate pickup lane, pre-batch by 16:30, and set pacing/throttle rules.
2) Launch Mon–Wed off-peak offers at 8:00 and 14:00 (combos, double points) and promote a fast pickup lane; set delivery minimums.
3) Audit AOV/discounts at 8:00, 14:00, 18:00 this week; cut underpriced deals, add family bundles and spend thresholds, and update delivery pricing.
